case_potbelly.title: BUILD-YOUR-OWN HYBRID DELIVERY™
case_potbelly.text: Potbelly explored Olo to upgrade their online ordering, but found delivery to be a dealbreaker. With Cartwheel, they secured a seamless, cost-effective solution for smooth operations and a better customer experience.
case_potbelly.rules_title: HYBRID DELIVERY RULES ARE BASED ON
case_potbelly.quote: With Cartwheel, our delivery program is as customizable as our menu. Potbelly is now able to offer faster, more efficient delivery from more than 400 locations nationwide.

dsp_solution.title: SEAMLESS CATERING DELIVERY SOLUTION
dsp_solution.sub: High-Performing DSPs, Reliable On-Time Rates, and Real-Time Visibility at Your Fingertips
items: We handpick top-performing, tech-enabled catering delivery providers (DSPs) to safeguard your reputation.
With an average on-time delivery rate of 97%, we continuously monitor DSPs and deliver detailed performance reports.
You get a clear dashboard with assigned drivers, real-time tracking, and direct contact for immediate support.

matching_fees.title: EFFECTIVE COST OF CARTWHEEL DISPATCH: MATCHING FEES
matching_fees.sub: Match customer delivery fees to the Cartwheel Dispatch fee to significantly reduce your operational costs
matching_fees.card1: Offset the Cartwheel Dispatch fee with the customer delivery fee
matching_fees.card2: We cover the delivery provider’s fees and ensure that 100% of customer tips go directly to the drivers
matching_fees.card3: According to ezCater, 90% of customers prefer restaurants that provide real-time tracking. Catering clients are also open to paying a premium for quality service with tracking

case_willys.title: STREAMLINED CATERING DELIVERY
case_willys.challenge: Willy’s faced growing catering demand with limited delivery visibility and separate systems for in-house and third-party drivers, leading to inefficiencies and inconsistent service
case_willys.solution: Willy’s adopted Cartwheel x MonkeyMedia, unifying catering orders and delivery tracking in one system and enabling hybrid delivery for in-house and third-party drivers
results: Improved delivery efficiency with real-time tracking
Enhanced customer experience and operational control
Smarter delivery management with AI-powered insights
case_willys.quote: The combination of MonkeyMedia Software and Cartwheel has transformed our catering delivery operations. The integration provides us with unprecedented visibility and control, significantly improving our efficiency and the customer experience.
case_willys.role: Sr. Director of Catering, Willy’s Mexicana Grill & Howlin’ Willy’s Hot Chicken

case_illegal_petes.title_html: CATERING DONE RIGHT: 930% INCREASE IN TIPS
case_illegal_petes.p1: Illegal Pete’s is a Colorado-based group of quick-service, fast-casual “Mission Style” burrito restaurants inspired by burritos popularized in San Francisco in the 1960s and 1970s.
case_illegal_petes.p2: Illegal Pete’s provides catering services using in-house drivers and has been doing so since 2001. Last year, the brand implemented Olo to power its online ordering and Cartwheel to enhance delivery management.
head: 3 MONTHS BEFORE SWITCHING TO OLO & CARTWHEEL
3 MONTHS AFTER SWITCHING TO OLO & CARTWHEEL
case_illegal_petes.quote: Our number of sales increased, the order value increased, delivery fees increased, and our tips increased across the board once we turned the portal on for the customers. We consider Cartwheel to be a critical piece in being able to put catering online through OLO. For us, one could not exist without the other as we have all in-house deliveries on our catering orders.

case_catalogue.title: SEAMLESS CATERING DELIVERY
case_catalogue.challenge: Catalogue was considering Toast Catering & Events, but delivery management was a dealbreaker.
case_catalogue.solution: By combining Toast Catering & Events with Cartwheel, Catalogue streamlined deliveries with top DSPs, real-time tracking, and white-glove support.
results: Launched reliable, professional delivery with a network of top DSPs
Introduced a cost-effective strategy that preserves margins
case_catalogue.quote: By combining Toast Catering with Cartwheel’s Dispatch, we ensure seamless, high-quality catering delivery with top-tier providers.
